test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Marked price of a chair is Rs. 5000. After giving two successive discounts of 10 percent and x percent, the chair is sold for Rs. 3150. What is the value of x?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of a chair = Rs. 5000

First discount = 10%

Second discount = x%

Selling price after discounts = Rs. 3150

**Concept:**

Successive discounts are applied one after the other on the remaining amount after each discount.

**Formula Used:**

Final Price = Marked Price × (1 - First Discount/100) × (1 - Second Discount/100)

**Calculation:**

Final Price = 5000 × (1 - 10/100) × (1 - x/100)

⇒ 3150 = 5000 × 0.9 × (1 - x/100)

⇒ 3150 = 4500 × (1 - x/100)

⇒ 3150/4500 = 1 - x/100

⇒ 0.7 = 1 - x/100

⇒ x/100 = 1 - 0.7

⇒ x/100 = 0.3

⇒ x = 0.3 × 100

⇒ x = 30

**∴ The value of x is 30 percent.**
